name: miles
description: Miles is an enterprise-facing reinforcement learning framework for LLM and VLM post-training, forked from and co-evolving with slime.
one_liner: A technical framework for large companies that lets them further train big AI models on their own data and feedback, rather than just using an off-the-shelf model.
buyer: An AI infrastructure engineer at a mid-to-large company building a custom fine-tuned model who needs the reinforcement-learning training pipeline, not just a base model.
business_use_cases: An enterprise AI team fine-tunes a customer-support model on their own historical tickets to outperform a generic model.
A robotics or vision company uses it to post-train a vision-language model on proprietary sensor data.
An AI startup uses it as the training backbone for a specialized model they plan to sell access to.

money_ideas.idea: Offer specialized RL fine-tuning consulting for enterprises who have the data and use-case but not the ML infrastructure expertise.

steal_this: Not a weekend project — this is deep infrastructure for teams already training models; the realistic opportunity is contract ML-engineering work, not a quick product.
